hints: Percent means "out of 100". So 10% is 10 out of 100.
No choice says "10 out of 100", so simplify 10/100.
Divide the top and the bottom of 10/100 by 10. Then find the choice that matches.

steps.action: Divide the top and the bottom by 10: 10 ÷ 10 = 1 and 100 ÷ 10 = 10.
steps.why: Dividing the top and the bottom by the same number keeps the value the same.
1 out of every 10 people is the same share as 10 out of every 100 people.

steps.action: 10% is the same as 1 out of 10.

trapNotes.10 out of 10: This is the whole thing, which is 100%. 10% is only a small part.
trapNotes.1 out of 100: This is 1%, not 10%. Divide both the top and the bottom of 10/100 by 10, not just the top.
trapNotes.10 out of 1,000: This is 1%. Percent compares with 100, not with 1,000.
